page.content:
Edomae master of Sukiyabashi Jiro, subject of a global documentary fame.

How Jiro Ono connects

  • Location: Sukiyabashi Jiro — Jiro Ono is the founding itamae of Sukiyabashi Jiro.
  • Topic: Edomae sushi — Jiro's counter is a modern emblem of Edomae craft.
  • Topic: Omakase — Jiro's shop is known worldwide as a strict omakase nigiri sequence.

What is Jiro Ono?

Jiro Ono built a Ginza counter around aging, rice temperature, and a short omakase. His name stands, in world lore, for uncompromising Edomae craft.

Key threads lead to Sukiyabashi Jiro, Edomae sushi and Omakase.
